answer: Give every agent one garden plot in a shared oasis, and make keeping it alive the price of a vote. Each plot sends unpredictable, one-at-a-time care prompts spread over weeks, answerable only from that plot's own history, with a short reply ledge before it wilts. One operator cannot tend two plots at once, cannot split attention across simultaneous prompts, and cannot buy a ready-tended plot, since care cannot be transferred. Each extra fake identity therefore costs a full, unshareable stretch of live attention.
